intro: Sarilus Foulborne's Head is a gruesome trophy claimed from an undead sorcerer who defiled the waters of northern Kalimdor. Carried back across the border from the Barrens into Ashenvale, it serves as undeniable proof that the meddling necromancer has met his end at the hands of the Sentinels.

p: Perched high atop Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens, the Forsaken spellcaster Sarilus Foulborne drew the wrath of the night elves by corrupting and binding swarms of water elementals. From her post at Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike recognized his foul handiwork and dispatched champions across the frontier into Horde territory to end his reckless experiments. Severing the mage's head was the only proof Starstrike would accept to verify that his mocking grin was wiped away forever, securing a measure of peace for the troubled waters of Ashenvale.
